title: Priority Queue
description:
Implement a min-heap `PriorityQueue` class where lower priority numbers are dequeued first.

- `push(item, priority)` — adds an item with a numeric priority
- `pop()` — removes and returns the item with the **lowest** priority number
- `peek()` — returns the item with the lowest priority without removing it
- `size` — number of items currently in the queue

**Example:**
```js
const pq = new PriorityQueue();
pq.push('low', 10);
pq.push('high', 1);
pq.push('mid', 5);
pq.pop();  // 'high'  (priority 1)
pq.pop();  // 'mid'   (priority 5)
pq.pop();  // 'low'   (priority 10)
```
ai_context: Common mistake: implementing with an array and sorting on every push (O(n log n)) instead of maintaining the heap property via bubble-up and sink-down (O(log n)). Also confusing min-heap vs max-heap comparison direction.
